result.title: The Standard Deviation in VICReg Buys a Safety Margin
result.summary: VICReg prevents collapse with a hinge on the standard deviation of each embedding dimension, and its authors argue from the gradient that a hinge on the variance would fail. To our knowledge, this claim has not been tested experimentally. We test it in a controlled setting (ResNet-18, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100), changing only the hinge and sweeping its weight $μ$ over five orders of magnitude. At the default weight ($μ= 1$), the two hinges reach the same linear-probe accuracy on CIFAR-10 (about 89.5%). Both collapse below a threshold weight, but the standard-deviation hinge's threshold is 35-130$\times$ lower. CIFAR-100 shows a consistent gap. In training, the variance hinge's gradient fades as the feature variance shrinks, while the standard-deviation hinge's does not until that variance is very small. The standard-deviation hinge therefore buys a safety margin: it keeps training at weights far below the point where the variance hinge collapses.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在受控设置（ResNet-18、CIFAR-10/100）下实验检验 VICReg 中「标准差 hinge」与「方差 hinge」的防坍缩差异，扫描权重 μ 五个数量级；结果显示默认权重下两者线性探针精度相近，但标准差 hinge 的崩溃阈值低 35–130 倍，其梯度在方差变小时衰减更慢，相当于多出安全裕度。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属自监督表示学习，不直接研究 VLM 推理；但其关于表示坍缩阈值与正则梯度衰减的分析，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态表示坍缩、正则强度选择与训练稳定性的借鉴线索。
